dance: First steps for people who believe they cannot dance (dance basics)
title: BEGINNER LINE DANCE - COWBOY HUSTLE - TUTORIAL!

method.teacher_system: The teacher breaks the dance into small, manageable chunks, demonstrating each one clearly from a back view. She then combines these chunks into a sequence, repeating the full routine multiple times to ensure the learner can follow along. Finally, she performs the entire dance to music to demonstrate the final result.
method.signature: The teacher uses a back view throughout the entire tutorial, allowing learners to mirror her movements without having to mentally flip left and right.

practices.what: The teacher breaks down the first movement, a fan motion with the right foot, into small, repeatable steps.
The teacher introduces the next chunk: two heel taps forward and two toe taps backward with the right foot.
The teacher combines the previous steps into a sequence of alternating heel and toe taps.
The teacher adds a new chunk: a step-kick-step-touch sequence, repeated twice.
The teacher introduces the 'grapevine' step, explaining it as a side-step, cross-behind, side-step, and touch.
The teacher adds a quarter turn to the grapevine step to change direction.
The teacher adds the final step: a step-touch-step-back sequence.
The teacher leads the learner through the entire routine from the beginning, putting all the learned chunks together.
The teacher performs the full dance routine to music, allowing the learner to see the steps in context.

adaptations.difficulty: The step-back movement might feel too simple or not energetic enough for some.
adaptations.adjustment: The teacher suggests adding a hop to the step-back movement for those who want more energy.

struggles.theme: Difficulty following along with other instructors

clicked.theme: Back view makes it easy to follow
Putting it all together at the end

method.limits: The video does not provide on-screen counts or step names, which might be helpful for some learners to track the rhythm.
